'''Erris Wyum''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who worked as an agent for [[Corellian Intelligence]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. His intelligence teams were responsible for gathering information on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] battle [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Eclipse (Harrower-class)|''Eclipse'']], allowing the [[Hero of Tython]] to board the cruiser and prevent its detonation.
